text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to remove the stop control from the northbound right-turn channel at the intersection of Legion Road North and Frederick G. Gardiner Expressway Eastbound Off-Ramp to Park Lawn Road. The proposed stop control removal is to be done in conjunction with the inclusion of the northbound right-turn channel within the existing traffic signal control operation at this intersection. Modifying the traffic control at the northbound right-turn channel from stop sign to traffic signals will address safety concerns with respect to northbound right-turning motorists from Legion Road North onto Frederick G. Gardiner Expressway Eastbound Off-Ramp to Park Lawn Road.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the removal of the stop control from the Legion Road North northbound right-turn channel at the intersection of Legion Road North and Frederick G. Gardiner Expressway Eastbound Off-Ramp to Park Lawn Road, in conjunction with the inclusion of the Legion Road North northbound right-turn channel within the existing traffic control signal operation at the intersection of Legion Road North and Frederick G. Gardiner Expressway Eastbound Off-Ramp to Park Lawn Road.
